tenderSchedule.title: Selection of an Agency for providing Specialized Technical Resources to the PMU of HRMS2 Directorate
tenderSchedule.description: Selection of an Agency for providing Specialized Technical Resources to the PMU of HRMS2 Directorate

tenderAddress.blockNumber: HRMS2 Directorate 5th Floor, KPCL Green Building, Drugs Control Department Annexe, Palace Road, Bangalore 560001

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Submission of Covering letter as required in the given format (Refer Appendix-1)

Furnishing of the Power of Attorney- (Power of Attorney executed by the bidder in favour of the Principal Officer or duly Authorized Representative, certifying him/her as an authorized signatory for the purpose of this Tender)
The bidder should be a company registered under the Companies Act or LLP act -Copy of Certificate of Incorporation should be provided.
Bidder should hold valid GST certificate and Permanent Account Number (PAN) -Copy of Valid GST certificate and Permanent Account Number (PAN) should be provided.

The bidder should have an annual turnover of at least 2 Crores every year, in last 3 years i.e. 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25 -(Certified copy from Chartered Accountant shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-2)

The bidder shall not be under declaration of ineligibility for corrupt or fraudulent practices or deficiencies of services or blacklisted with any of the Government agencies at the time of bidding.-(A declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix 4.)
Submission of Declaration of Acceptance of Terms & Conditions to RFP in the given format-(A declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-5)
Submission of Undertaking on litigation(s) in the given format-(A declaration signed by Authorized signatory shall be provided as per the format given in Appendix-6)

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Experience in providing the technical resources in India with a project value more than Rs. two crores each in Government and Public Sector units in India.(Completed or Ongoing project with workorders)

Consulting experience involving the IT project management Consultancy / technical services in activities in India with a project value more than Rs. 50 Lakhs each in Government and Public Sector units in India. (Completed or Ongoing project with workorders)

Project Experience of working on a state level HRMS project in providing technical resources / advisory services with Government organizations within India (Completed or Ongoing project with workorders)
Organization Certificates 1.ISO 9001-2015 2. CMMI Level 3 or above 3.ISO 27001
Average Annual Turnover of the bidder (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: 1. Shall hold a BTECH / BE Degree 2. Total Experience shall be more than 10 years 3.
